titles: 15 Things From the 70s You Don't See Anymore (#1 Was Everywhere)
15 Everyday Things From the 1970s That Quietly Vanished
15 Things Every 70s Home Had That Your Grandkids Have Never Seen
thumbnail_prompt: Warm 1970s living room close-up: a heavy amber glass ashtray sits center on a wooden coffee table, a laughing middle-aged man in a brown cardigan on a corduroy sofa behind it, soft lamp glow, wood paneling, bottom quarter plain dark carpet.
curiosity_gap: Which ordinary object did every 1970s home, office and car have, and why did it vanish so completely that it now looks shocking?
open_loop: And number one? It sat on every coffee table, every office desk and every car dashboard in America and Canada. Today it has almost completely disappeared, yet believe it or not, one place is still required by law to have one.
